title: Review and freeze the HUE product contract
goal: Freeze HUE as a personal workspace with Projects, Areas, Resources, independent Sessions, portable knowledge and replaceable execution backends before implementation choices harden accidentally.
scope: Review every product chapter and interactive prototype
Confirm the Space/Project/Area/Resource and Session/task/run distinctions
Confirm source ownership, OpenCode-first coding and non-omniscient orchestrator principles
Create a versioned v0 product-contract tag
acceptance: The original and expanded visions are represented without contradiction
Projects, Areas, Resources, Sessions and source ownership are visible in the prototype
Non-goals and alpha scope are accepted

title: ADR: choose HUE product boundary, app shell and control-plane stack
goal: Decide HUE’s owned personal-workspace boundary and the replaceable relationship to Hermes/OpenCode plus the application shell and control plane.
scope: Spike Tauri, browser+daemon and existing Hermes WebUI extension packaging paths around the accepted SvelteKit frontend
Compare TypeScript, Rust, Python/Hermes-derived and split daemon control-plane options
Document HUE ownership of Spaces, Sessions, context packs and task state
Document reuse/adapter boundaries for Hermes and OpenCode
Honor ADR-0001: SvelteKit + Svelte 5 + shadcn-svelte is fixed; do not reopen React versus Svelte inside the shell decision
acceptance: ADR covers the unresolved packaging portion of TBD-001 plus TBD-002 and TBD-004
At least one runnable thin spike per packaging/control-plane finalist
Every finalist hosts or serves the accepted SvelteKit frontend without making backend-native session/memory canonical
Decision scores recovery, packaging, native integration, reuse, accessibility and contributor ergonomics
Consequences and migration path are explicit
ADR-0001 and resolved TBD-020 remain authoritative unless a documented revisit trigger fires

title: ADR: choose canonical storage, event journal and application transport
goal: Select durable local state, semantic events, canonical-versus-derived data and client transport foundations for Spaces, Sessions and source projections.
scope: Prototype SQLite/event append and cursor resume
Model canonical HUE state versus rebuildable search/vector/source projections
Compare local HTTP/SSE/WS, JSON-RPC and embedded IPC
acceptance: Backup, migration and cursor semantics defined
Canonical HUE data, portable files, source authority and rebuildable indexes are explicit

title: ADR: choose orchestration foundation and v0 worker/runtime contracts
goal: Choose the smallest durable scheduler/router core and freeze provider-neutral worker plus runtime lifecycle contracts, including the first OpenCode adapter mode.
scope: Compare custom state machine with Magentic, LangGraph, Mastra and ADK concepts
Define Space/Session attachment, plan, worker, adapter, steering and reconciliation contracts
Specify depth, budget and topology defaults
acceptance: ADR resolves TBD-003, TBD-005, TBD-009 and TBD-024
At least one fake adapter passes contract tests

title: Create HUE threat model and alpha security baseline
goal: Turn the trust assumptions into testable boundaries before privileged execution is implemented.
scope: Map assets, actors, boundaries and abuse cases
Define risk classes and policy enforcement points
acceptance: Threat model covers model, context, filesystem, shell, browser, computer use, plugins, sync and updates
Security invariants map to planned tests
Review cadence and disclosure path defined

title: ADR: choose open-source license and project governance
goal: Adopt an explicit license and contributor/governance model suitable for an open agent workspace.
scope: Compare Apache-2.0, MPL-2.0, AGPL-3.0 and dual/community approaches
acceptance: Repository gains selected license and notices
Contributor expectations and decision authority are documented

title: Build the local HUE shell and supervised control-plane skeleton
goal: Create the minimum packaged app/service that starts, reports health and shuts down safely.
scope: Implement selected shell and local service boundary
Add readiness/health and structured startup diagnostics
acceptance: Service restart is detected by client
Child ownership and shutdown are verified

title: Implement schema migrations and append-only semantic event journal
goal: Provide transactional canonical storage and resumable semantic event history.
scope: Append events atomically with state transitions
acceptance: Interrupted transaction does not expose partial state

title: Implement Space manifests plus Project/Area CRUD and archive lifecycle
goal: Persist Projects and ongoing Areas as explicit Space subtypes with common boundaries and distinct lifecycle semantics.
scope: Create Space, Project and Area schemas/migrations
Keep repository/milestone fields Project-only and review-cadence/evidence policy Area-specific
acceptance: Project and Area persist across restart
Archive/export preserves context-pack and source relationships
Deletion impact preview lists Sessions, tasks, knowledge and bindings

title: Implement trusted Space resource roots and filesystem boundary validation
goal: Enforce resource-root policy for Projects and Areas outside model prompts.
acceptance: Escapes and unauthorized roots are denied

title: Build Project/Area overview, shared Space tabs and onboarding flows
goal: Expose coherent Space navigation while preserving meaningful Project versus Area behavior.
scope: Build template-based Area onboarding without repository assumptions
Implement empty, degraded and archived states
acceptance: Space tabs and terminology are consistent
Area UI never invents branches/worktrees unless linked

title: Implement typed Space-bound Sessions, messages, summaries and branches
goal: Allow concurrent independent discussion, execution, research, monitoring and review Sessions without shared mutable context.
scope: Persist Session type, Space binding and lifecycle
Implement messages, branches, attachments and backend-handle references
Create working summaries without promoting them to Space memory
Support concurrent active Sessions and explicit type transitions
acceptance: Two concurrent Sessions in different Spaces cannot leak messages/context
Discussion can create a linked execution Session/task
Backend handle can be replaced without losing HUE Session

title: Implement portable context packs and versioned context manifests
goal: Assemble least-context Session/worker inputs from human-readable Space files plus explicit sources and record exact immutable manifests.
scope: Hash/version included files, knowledge and source records
Expose inclusion reasons, omissions and budget
acceptance: Context pack is readable/editable without HUE
Run can reproduce exact ordered sources/version/policy
Historical manifest is unchanged after file edits
User can preview and reject proposed durable updates

title: Implement global, Space, source and episodic memory lifecycle with provenance
goal: Keep preferences, current Space state, authoritative-source facts and archived episodes separate and correctable.
scope: Implement four memory layers and proposal lifecycle
Add provenance, sensitivity, freshness, supersession and retention
Prevent workers from direct shared-memory writes
acceptance: Stale source memory is visibly stale
Closed Session stays searchable but is not injected by default

title: Build knowledge/memory center, context-pack editor and “Why this context?” inspector
goal: Make maintained knowledge, memory layers and exact retrieval inspectable and correctable.
scope: Show context-pack roles and version history
Preview proposed edits and context manifests
acceptance: User can answer why a source was loaded
Raw transcript is not mislabeled as durable knowledge
Source freshness and authority are visible

title: Add cross-Space isolation, retrieval and context regression suite
goal: Prove Project/Area/Resource boundaries and explicit cross-Space links prevent accidental retrieval leakage.
scope: Create two-project fixtures with conflicting/private facts
Exercise context assembly, search and memory operations
acceptance: No cross-project leakage in manifests or search
Global allowlisted preference appears as expected

title: Implement durable task, run, plan and step state machines
goal: Represent assigned outcomes and execution attempts truthfully across restarts.
scope: Model waiting, interrupted, unknown, unverified and verified
acceptance: Task and run statuses remain distinct

title: Build semantic event projections and live run stream
goal: Turn immutable run events into durable UI-readable projections.
acceptance: Page refresh reconstructs identical task state

title: Implement first native worker and deterministic verification path
goal: Execute one scoped worker end to end under HUE ownership.
scope: Produce artifact claim and independent readback
acceptance: Artifact is verified outside worker prose

title: Build task plan and live run inspector UI
goal: Show the user what is happening, why and what needs attention.
scope: Render plan steps/dependencies and current worker
Expose semantic timeline and advanced runtime details

title: Implement restart reconciliation, checkpoints and outcome bundles
goal: Recover truthful execution state and produce evidence-backed completion.
scope: Generate outcome bundle and recovery choices
acceptance: Missing worker becomes interrupted/unknown as appropriate

title: Implement versioned worker catalog and manifest validation
goal: Define safe temporary specialist classes without permanent bot sprawl.
acceptance: Manifest version is recorded per worker

title: Implement capability-based route policy and precedence
goal: Resolve provider-neutral needs into approved runtime/model/effort routes.
scope: Implement capability request and route schema
Apply safety > user > task > project > global > worker defaults
acceptance: Explicit user override wins within safety
Invalid policy uses approved fallback or fails closed

title: Add provider/runtime health, quota, budget and fallback handling
goal: Adapt routes safely to real provider availability and budgets.

title: Implement adaptive orchestrator planning, dependencies and replanning
goal: Implement a bounded scheduler/router that proposes inbox destination, attaches Space context, plans only when useful, handles dependencies, prevents conflicts and replans from evidence.
scope: Add Inbox destination and Session-type proposal hook
Schedule ready steps and parallel safe branches
Replan with immutable revisions and explanation
Route results and proposed Space-state updates
acceptance: Simple fixture avoids unnecessary multi-agent plan
Inbox fixture receives correctable Space/Session proposal

title: Build routing policy, explanation and evaluation workbench
goal: Let users inspect, simulate and improve automatic routing.
scope: Golden task runner and route outcome metrics
acceptance: User can see why a route won

title: Implement repository service and managed worktree lifecycle
goal: Provide safe isolated repository execution owned by HUE.
acceptance: Main workspace remains untouched by default
Cleanup never deletes unmerged work silently

title: Implement OpenCode-first coding worker adapter with scoped terminal and file tools
goal: Make OpenCode the primary v0 software execution backend while HUE retains canonical Session/task/policy/evidence state.
scope: Implement adapter mode selected by TBD-024
Inject versioned context and least-capability grants
Bind repository/worktree/GitHub issue and normalize events
Capture usage, changed files and verification evidence
acceptance: Real OpenCode task modifies only managed worktree
Normalized events do not expose backend-specific UI coupling
An alternate adapter can satisfy same contract

title: Build artifact, changed-files and diff review workspace
goal: Review code and generated artifacts in the same project/task context.

title: Ingest test/build evidence and add independent review loop
goal: Make coding completion depend on evidence and independent review.
scope: Spawn read-only reviewer under independence policy
Feed accepted findings back and reverify
acceptance: Worker self-report alone cannot verify task

title: Implement commit, merge and pull-request approval handoff
goal: Move verified work into version-control collaboration only with explicit authority.
scope: Read back remote object and link evidence
acceptance: PR body links task and evidence

title: Implement capability policy engine and scoped expiring grants
goal: Enforce least-capability access outside model prompts.
acceptance: Project and user policy precedence is tested

title: Build approval inbox, preview and decision scopes
goal: Let users understand and decide consequential actions without blind consent.

title: Implement isolated browser worker with prompt-injection boundaries
goal: Perform interactive web tasks in isolated, policy-controlled browser contexts.
scope: Isolated browser profiles and domain policy
acceptance: Page instructions cannot change system policy
Final state and URL are verified

title: Integrate scoped computer-use backend and live monitor
goal: Operate native applications visibly with capture-act-verify and takeover.
scope: Backend adapter, app/window scoping and action events
acceptance: S11 workflow works on reference macOS

title: Implement external side-effect ledger and adversarial safety suite
goal: Prevent unsafe retries and prove browser/computer/tool boundaries under attack.
scope: Run prompt injection, approval replay, secret leak and cancellation fixtures

title: Publish runtime adapter SDK and conformance suite
goal: Let external runtimes implement HUE worker lifecycle without product-specific coupling.

title: Implement Hermes runtime adapter
goal: Reuse Hermes provider/tools/skills strengths through the HUE runtime contract.
acceptance: Hermes memory cannot bypass HUE scopes

title: Implement Codex and Claude Code adapter pilots
goal: Prove OpenCode is a first backend rather than a permanent dependency by running equivalent fixtures through alternate coding runtimes.
scope: Document capability differences and fallback limits
acceptance: Both pilots pass applicable conformance fixtures
No HUE Space/Session schema changes required

title: Implement MCP/plugin mediation and deterministic job adapter
goal: Extend capabilities without growing an unsafe core or calling LLMs unnecessarily.
acceptance: Deterministic task can run with zero model calls

title: Build onboarding, health diagnostics and recovery center
goal: Make local setup and failure recovery understandable without terminal archaeology.
scope: Health matrix and redacted diagnostics export
acceptance: Safe local project possible before cloud provider

title: Implement backup, restore, export/import and retention controls
goal: Protect user ownership and recoverability of HUE data.

title: Package signed alpha with safe updates, accessibility and responsive attention surface
goal: Deliver an installable, accessible local alpha with safe migration/update behavior.
scope: WCAG checks and mobile attention/approval layouts
acceptance: Update with paused run preserves recovery

title: Run alpha threat, golden-task, performance and dogfood release gates
goal: Prove the release meets outcome, trust, comprehension and recovery contracts.
scope: Dogfood HUE building a bounded HUE issue
acceptance: All alpha release blockers have evidence
Known risks are documented and accepted
Release notes and outcome bundles published

title: Implement Resource library and explicit Space relationships
goal: Represent reusable people, reading, templates and archives without granting global implicit access.
scope: Add Resources navigation/search and access preview
acceptance: Resource can relate to multiple Spaces
Unlink does not delete underlying user file
non_goals: Build a generic graph database UI

title: Implement portable second-brain relationships, backlinks and epistemic provenance
goal: Make HUE knowledge human-readable, linked, versioned and useful without any model or runtime.
scope: Implement backlinks, tags and explicit Space/Resource relationships
Implement epistemic types and proposed revision flow
acceptance: Observation, inference, evidence, advice, decision and uncertainty remain distinct
Worker output cannot silently become durable knowledge

title: Implement authoritative-source bindings and staleness-aware projections
goal: Keep GitHub, Calendar, email and user files authoritative while giving HUE normalized, freshness-aware control surfaces.
scope: Build read-only GitHub issue/PR projection first
Store native IDs, locator, version/etag and freshness
Define conflict and explicit writeback path
acceptance: GitHub remains source of truth for issue/PR
Stale projection is never presented as current
Connector can be replaced without rewriting Space/Session records
non_goals: Implement Calendar/email writeback in first slice

title: Build universal inbox routing proposals and correction workflow
goal: Let users capture unfiled work while HUE proposes a correctable destination Space, Session type, topic and expected output.
scope: Create Inbox capture and routing-proposal records
Record transparent user corrections without hidden permanent learning
Dispatch accepted item into a Session/task
acceptance: Proposal shows original text and rationale
User can change each field before dispatch
Keep in inbox performs no hidden work
Dispatch creates exactly one idempotent destination object

title: Implement Session summaries and structured Space-state update proposals
goal: Turn completed work into concise resumable Session summaries and reviewable updates to current state/decisions/active work.
scope: Link evidence, source records and superseded state
acceptance: No durable Space update occurs without policy/user acceptance
Accepted change updates canonical file/record and indexes
Rejected proposal remains audit-visible but unretrieved
Old current state is superseded rather than silently overwritten
non_goals: Copy full transcript into context pack

title: ADR: choose portable context-pack and authoritative-source synchronization contracts
goal: Decide exact portable file roles/metadata and source ownership/synchronization semantics before implementing the second-brain and connectors.
scope: Define canonical file versus database projection rules
Define GitHub/Calendar/email ownership, freshness, polling/webhook and writeback conflict rules
acceptance: Representative Project and Area packs are human-readable without HUE
Conflict and offline behavior are specified

title: ADR: choose notification gateways, phone attention surface and delivery privacy
goal: Resolve the local and phone notification architecture without making a HUE cloud account mandatory or leaking sensitive task content.
scope: Compare native OS notifications and sound APIs on the reference desktop platform
Compare native/companion push, PWA web push, self-hosted or encrypted relay, Telegram and email fallback
Define endpoint registration, authenticated deep links, lock-screen privacy and channel acknowledgement semantics
Define durable queue, deduplication, retry, expiry, quiet-hours and operating-cost constraints
Choose the alpha phone attention surface and document migration/fallback paths
acceptance: ADR resolves TBD-013 and the alpha portion of TBD-014, explicitly accounting for TBD-017
At least one local desktop/sound spike and one phone-delivery spike produce measured evidence
No-cloud local mode and a secure opt-in phone path are both preserved
Payload minimization, token storage, device revocation, deep-link authentication and receipts are specified
The chosen path distinguishes queued, accepted, displayed/delivered, failed, expired, read and acted without fabricated certainty

title: Implement durable notification center, attention policy and local sound/desktop delivery
goal: Make meaningful task outcomes and attention needs durable, calm and locally visible even after HUE restarts.
scope: Implement Notification, NotificationEndpoint and NotificationDelivery records plus migrations
Consume semantic events by durable cursor and apply class, urgency, sensitivity, grouping and deduplication policy
Build notification center, unread count, filters, deep links and per-item delivery detail
Implement task subscriptions, per-Space overrides, quiet hours, mute, grouping, completion-duration threshold and retention
Integrate reference-platform OS notifications and configurable completion/attention sounds
Persist local delivery attempts, retry/expiry state and channel health diagnostics
acceptance: A verified long-running task creates exactly one canonical in-app outcome, one configured OS alert and one sound
Completed-unverified, verified, failed, cancelled and unknown outcomes remain distinct
Restart between event creation and delivery produces no lost or duplicate canonical notification
Worker-event bursts group under the task outcome and emit at most one sound
Quiet hours, local-only Space policy, disabled/unauthorized channels and retention are covered by automated tests
Keyboard, screen-reader and reduced-motion behavior passes the documented accessibility contract
non_goals: Ship phone push or third-party messaging gateways
Make raw runtime logs a notification source

title: Implement secure phone notifications, redacted deep links and delivery diagnostics
goal: Alert the user on an authorized phone when long work finishes or needs attention without exposing sensitive HUE content or weakening approval policy.
scope: Implement the phone gateway and mobile attention surface selected by HUE-051
Register, authorize, test and revoke devices/endpoints using vault-backed credentials
Render generic/title/redacted-summary payloads under global and Space privacy policy
Implement authenticated deep links that re-fetch canonical task, approval or recovery state
Add durable queue, bounded retry, expiry, acknowledgement mapping, fallback and endpoint health
Add safe reminder/escalation behavior for unread blocking attention
acceptance: An opt-in phone receives a redacted verified-completion alert and opens the current evidence-backed completion card
Sensitive/local-only Space policy prevents title, content, paths and artifacts from leaving the host
Offline queue, restart, duplicate provider responses, token revocation and gateway outage tests pass
Provider accepted, delivered/displayed when supported, read and acted remain separate states
Consequential approvals require the authenticated HUE attention surface and cannot be granted blindly from a third-party channel
Phone delivery is optional; local notification history and desktop/sound behavior work without a HUE-operated account

title: Implement the HUE Svelte component foundation with shadcn-svelte
goal: Establish an accessible, source-owned component and token foundation that feels native across HUE desktop and responsive surfaces without making the library the product identity.
scope: Implement the accepted SvelteKit + Svelte 5 + shadcn-svelte direction from ADR-0001
Define HUE semantic color, typography, spacing, radius, elevation, density, motion and state tokens as CSS variables
Implement buttons, inputs, tabs, menus, tooltips, dialogs, sheets, popovers, command palette, badges, tables and toast primitives
Wrap source-owned shadcn-svelte primitives behind HUE component APIs so upstream library changes do not leak through product screens
Create dark, light, high-contrast and reduced-motion examples plus desktop and mobile visual-regression fixtures
Use the static prototype token and component mapping as the migration fixture
Proceed independently of TBD-001 packaging: every shell finalist must host or serve this accepted frontend foundation
acceptance: Implementation follows ADR-0001 and documents source/update ownership
HUE tokens—not shadcn defaults—control product identity and semantic task/approval/notification states
Keyboard, focus return, screen-reader labels and 44px touch targets pass automated and manual checks
Dialogs, menus, sheets and command palette follow platform-appropriate interaction conventions
Representative shell, approval and notification fixtures pass dark/light desktop and 390px mobile visual regression
No screen imports low-level shadcn-svelte primitives directly outside the HUE component boundary
Static-to-Svelte fixture parity is documented before any static screen is retired
non_goals: Copy the stock shadcn theme unchanged
Claim OS-native controls where HUE renders web components
Select or reopen the TBD-001 application packaging and control-plane decision
Migrate all functional prototype screens before their flows stabilize
